clarification.question: "Apple iPad" covers several current models. Which one do you mean? Please specify the family (iPad, iPad mini, iPad Air, or iPad Pro), screen size, storage capacity, and whether you want Wi-Fi or Wi-Fi + Cellular.

candidates.label: Apple iPad (A16, 11-inch class) 128GB Wi-Fi
candidates.detail: Base iPad family; price rises by storage (256GB, 512GB) and cellular. Sources cite $449 (Apple US list, Nov 2026) though one article lists $349 for the same family, so the current price is unverified.

candidates.label: Apple iPad mini (A20 Pro) 128GB Wi-Fi
candidates.detail: Smallest iPad with OLED display and A20 Pro chip; listed around $699 for 128GB Wi-Fi. Different size and chip from the base iPad.

candidates.label: Apple iPad Air 11-inch (M4) 128GB Wi-Fi
candidates.detail: Mid-tier iPad with M4 chip and LCD display; 11-inch is the lower-priced size (about $749 at 128GB Wi-Fi per sources).

candidates.label: Apple iPad Air 13-inch (M4) 128GB Wi-Fi
candidates.detail: Same M4 Air as the 11-inch but larger 13-inch screen; about $200 more than the 11-inch (about $949 at 128GB Wi-Fi per sources).

candidates.label: Apple iPad Pro 11-inch (M5) 256GB Wi-Fi
candidates.detail: Professional tier with M5 chip, ProMotion and Tandem OLED; 13-inch Pro is a separate size (about $1,499 at base storage per sources); 256GB is the lowest storage tier for the 11-inch Pro.
